_meta.about: Nifty 500 companies H to K in the v2 format. Leaders checked against web reports in Oct 2026 where possible; others marked not re-checked. India Cements skipped as an UltraTech subsidiary.
_meta.review: All entries unreviewed until the founder approves them.

companies.name: Himadri Speciality Chemical

parts.SELLS: Himadri turns coal tar into industrial chemicals. Its main products are coal tar pitch, used by aluminium smelters and graphite electrode makers, plus carbon black for tyres, naphthalene and speciality oils. It is also building materials for lithium-ion batteries.
parts.EARNS: It earns by converting a low-value by-product of steelmaking into higher-value chemicals sold to aluminium, tyre and electrode makers. Coal tar pitch and carbon black bring in most of its revenue, while speciality grades carry better margins.
parts.SIZE: One of India's largest makers of coal tar pitch and a meaningful player in Indian carbon black. It is one of the few Indian chemical companies pushing into battery materials.
parts.RIVALS: Rain Industries (Rain Carbon) and Epsilon Carbon in coal tar products. In carbon black it competes with PCBL Chemical and Aditya Birla's Birla Carbon.
parts.WATCH: Watch its planned plant for battery anode materials and its stake in Australia's Sicona Battery Technologies, along with demand for pitch from aluminium smelters and for carbon black from tyre makers.

quiz.prompt: Which industry is a key buyer of Himadri's coal tar pitch?
Which company is a rival to Himadri in carbon black?
Which new area is Himadri building into?

companies.note_30w: Himadri turns coal tar into pitch for aluminium smelters, carbon black for tyres and speciality chemicals, and is now building materials for lithium-ion batteries.

companies.name: Hindustan Copper

parts.SELLS: Government-owned Hindustan Copper mines copper ore and sells copper concentrate and refined copper. Its mines are at Malanjkhand in Madhya Pradesh, Khetri in Rajasthan and Ghatsila in Jharkhand. Buyers include smelters, cable makers and traders.
parts.EARNS: It earns by mining ore and selling copper in concentrate or refined form, so its income moves closely with global copper prices. Concentrate from its Malanjkhand mine is the backbone of its sales.
parts.SIZE: India's only vertically integrated copper producer, from mining to refining, and the holder of most of the country's copper ore leases. It is small next to global miners.
parts.RIVALS: Hindalco's Birla Copper, Vedanta's Sterlite Copper and Adani's Kutch Copper in smelting and refining, plus imported copper from global miners.
parts.WATCH: Anupam Misra took over as CMD in July 2026. Watch its plans to expand mine output, especially underground mining at Malanjkhand, and its evaluation of copper blocks in Chile as India pushes for critical minerals.

quiz.prompt: Where is Hindustan Copper's Malanjkhand mine?
What mainly drives Hindustan Copper's earnings?
Who became Hindustan Copper's CMD in July 2026?

companies.note_30w: Government-owned Hindustan Copper is India's only integrated copper miner, selling concentrate and refined copper. Earnings track copper prices; it plans bigger mines and Chilean blocks.

companies.name: Hitachi Energy India

parts.SELLS: Hitachi Energy India makes equipment that moves electricity across the grid: power transformers, high-voltage direct current (HVDC) systems, substations and grid automation software. Buyers include Power Grid, state utilities, renewable developers, railways and data centres.
parts.EARNS: It earns from selling and installing grid equipment and from service contracts. Transformers and large HVDC and substation projects bring in most of its revenue, and exports to group companies abroad add to it.
parts.SIZE: One of India's leading suppliers of power transmission equipment and the Indian arm of Japan's Hitachi Energy. It is among the few firms in India able to deliver HVDC links.
parts.RIVALS: Siemens Energy India, GE Vernova T&D India, CG Power and Bharat Heavy Electricals (BHEL), along with Chinese and Korean transformer makers.
parts.WATCH: Watch its announced factory expansions for transformers and other grid gear, and how it delivers large HVDC orders tied to carrying renewable power from Rajasthan and Gujarat to cities.

quiz.prompt: What does HVDC, a Hitachi Energy India product, carry?
Which company competes with Hitachi Energy India?
What is Hitachi Energy India expanding?

companies.note_30w: Hitachi Energy India makes transformers, HVDC systems and grid software for utilities and renewable developers, and is expanding factories as India builds out its power grid.

companies.name: Home First Finance

parts.SELLS: Home First gives small home loans to first-time buyers, mostly salaried and self-employed families on modest incomes who struggle to get bank loans. It also offers loans against property and lends for home construction and extensions.
parts.EARNS: It earns the gap between the interest it charges borrowers and what it pays to borrow from banks and the National Housing Bank. Home loans are almost all of its book, with Gujarat, Maharashtra and Tamil Nadu its biggest markets.
parts.SIZE: One of India's leading affordable housing finance companies, though far smaller than mainstream lenders like HDFC Bank or LIC Housing Finance.
parts.RIVALS: Aavas Financiers, Aptus Value Housing, Aadhar Housing Finance and India Shelter Finance, plus small-ticket home loans from banks.
parts.WATCH: Watch its branch expansion into new states, how its borrowers repay as interest rates move, and the cost of its bank funding.

quiz.prompt: Who are Home First's main customers?
options: First-time home buyers on modest incomes

quiz.prompt: Which is a direct rival of Home First?
How does Home First mainly make money?

companies.note_30w: Home First lends small home loans to first-time buyers with modest incomes, earning an interest spread. Gujarat, Maharashtra and Tamil Nadu lead its book.

companies.name: Honeywell Automation India

parts.SELLS: Honeywell Automation India sells control systems that run refineries, chemical plants and factories, plus building technology such as fire alarms, security and climate controls. It also does engineering and software work for Honeywell units worldwide.
parts.EARNS: It earns from automation systems, projects and long service contracts. Process automation for oil, gas and chemical plants is its biggest business, with building solutions and export services adding the rest.
parts.SIZE: One of India's leading industrial and building automation companies and the listed Indian arm of US-based Honeywell International.
parts.RIVALS: ABB India, Siemens, Emerson, Schneider Electric India and Yokogawa in automation and building controls.
parts.WATCH: Its US parent is splitting into separate companies, with automation as a standalone business. Watch how the Indian listed arm fits in that new structure and how demand from refinery and chemical projects holds up.

quiz.prompt: What is Honeywell Automation India's biggest business?
Which company competes with Honeywell Automation India?
What change at its US parent should you watch?

companies.note_30w: Honeywell Automation India sells control systems for refineries and factories plus building safety tech. Watch how it fits as its US parent splits into separate companies.

companies.name: HUDCO

parts.SELLS: Housing and Urban Development Corporation (HUDCO) is a government-owned lender that funds housing and city infrastructure. It lends to state governments and their agencies for water supply, roads, metro rail, power and affordable housing, with a small retail home-loan book.
parts.EARNS: It earns interest on long-term loans, mostly to state governments and state-backed agencies, which keeps credit risk lower than private lending. Infrastructure loans make up most of its book.
parts.SIZE: One of India's largest government lenders for urban infrastructure and housing, and a Navratna public sector company.
parts.RIVALS: Power Finance Corporation, REC, IIFCL and NaBFID in infrastructure lending, plus State Bank of India and other banks that fund state projects.
parts.WATCH: Watch how fast states draw loans for water, transport and housing projects, the quality of its state-backed book, and its borrowing costs.

quiz.prompt: Who are HUDCO's main borrowers?
Which is a rival government lender to HUDCO?
Why is HUDCO's credit risk relatively low?

companies.note_30w: Government-owned HUDCO lends to state governments and agencies for housing, water, roads and metros, earning interest on long-term, mostly state-backed loans.

companies.name: ICICI Prudential AMC

parts.SELLS: ICICI Prudential AMC runs ICICI Prudential Mutual Fund, offering equity, debt, hybrid and index funds, plus portfolio management and alternative funds. It is a joint venture of ICICI Bank and the UK's Prudential plc, and listed in December 2025.
parts.EARNS: It earns management fees charged as a share of the money it manages. Equity funds earn higher fees than debt funds, so equity schemes and steady SIP inflows from retail savers drive most of its profit.
parts.SIZE: One of India's two largest mutual fund houses, alongside SBI Mutual Fund, with one of the biggest bases of retail savers.
parts.RIVALS: SBI Funds Management, HDFC AMC, Nippon Life India AMC and Kotak Mahindra AMC, plus low-cost index fund houses.
parts.WATCH: Watch SEBI's changes to the expense limits mutual funds can charge, which affect fee income, and whether monthly SIP inflows stay strong.

quiz.prompt: Which two companies jointly own ICICI Prudential AMC?
How does ICICI Prudential AMC mainly make money?
Which fund house is its closest rival in size?

companies.note_30w: ICICI Prudential AMC runs one of India's two biggest mutual fund houses, earning fees on money managed. Listed in December 2025; watch SEBI's expense rules.

companies.name: IDBI Bank

parts.SELLS: IDBI Bank offers savings and current accounts, home and personal loans, business loans and other banking services across India. Once a development finance institution, it is now a universal bank owned mostly by the government and LIC.
parts.EARNS: It earns the gap between interest on loans and what it pays depositors, plus fees. Retail loans such as home loans now make up the bigger part of its book after years of cutting risky corporate lending.
parts.SIZE: A mid-sized Indian bank with a nationwide branch network. It cleaned up a large pile of bad loans and returned to steady profits.
parts.RIVALS: Public sector banks such as Bank of Baroda, Canara Bank and Union Bank of India, and private lenders such as Federal Bank and IndusInd Bank.
parts.WATCH: The government and LIC are selling a controlling stake. Fairfax Financial and Emirates NBD are the bidders, and the sale resumed in 2026 after earlier bids fell short of the government's reserve price.

quiz.prompt: Who mainly owns IDBI Bank today?
Which bidders are in the race for IDBI Bank?
Which bank is a rival to IDBI Bank?

companies.note_30w: IDBI Bank is a mid-sized bank owned mostly by the government and LIC, now retail-focused. Watch the controlling-stake sale to Fairfax or Emirates NBD.

companies.name: IFCI

parts.SELLS: IFCI, set up in 1948 as India's first development finance institution, gives long-term loans to infrastructure and industrial projects. It is government-owned and works as an agency for government schemes. Its group includes StockHolding Corporation of India and IFCI Factors.
parts.EARNS: It earns interest on project loans, fees from managing government schemes, and income from subsidiaries. StockHolding, a large custodian and depository participant, is a key part of group income.
parts.SIZE: A small lender today next to banks and bigger state lenders, but one of the oldest names in Indian project finance.
parts.RIVALS: Power Finance Corporation, REC, IIFCL and SIDBI in long-term and development lending, plus banks that fund industrial projects.
parts.WATCH: Watch its recovery of old bad loans and how the government reshapes its subsidiaries. A new deputy MD joined in April 2026.

quiz.prompt: When was IFCI set up?
Which IFCI group company is a large custodian?
Which is a rival to IFCI in development lending?

companies.note_30w: IFCI, India's first development finance institution, is a government-owned project lender and scheme agency whose group includes StockHolding. Watch bad-loan recovery and subsidiary restructuring.

companies.name: IIFL Finance

parts.SELLS: IIFL Finance lends to individuals and small businesses: gold loans, home loans through IIFL Home Finance, loans to small businesses, and microfinance through IIFL Samasta. It reaches customers through a large branch network and digital partners.
parts.EARNS: It earns interest on loans. Gold loans and home loans are its largest businesses, with gold loans the most profitable because they are short and backed by jewellery.
parts.SIZE: One of India's largest diversified non-bank lenders and among the top gold loan companies.
parts.RIVALS: Muthoot Finance and Manappuram Finance in gold loans, Aavas and Aptus in affordable home loans, and Bajaj Finance in small business lending.
parts.WATCH: RBI stopped its new gold lending in March 2024 and lifted the ban that September. Watch how its gold book grows under RBI's newer gold loan rules and how microfinance repayments hold up.

quiz.prompt: Which IIFL Finance business is the most profitable?
Which company is a rival in gold loans?
What did RBI do to IIFL Finance in March 2024?

companies.note_30w: IIFL Finance lends gold, home, small business and microfinance loans. Gold loans are most profitable; watch growth after RBI's 2024 ban was lifted.

companies.name: INOX India (INOXCVA)

parts.SELLS: INOX India, known as INOXCVA, makes cryogenic tanks and systems that store and move super-cold gases such as LNG, liquid oxygen, nitrogen and hydrogen. It also builds LNG fuel tanks for trucks and equipment for space programmes and science projects such as ITER. It listed in December 2023.
parts.EARNS: It earns by selling engineered tanks and systems to gas companies, LNG users, space and science agencies. Industrial gas equipment is its largest business, while LNG and custom space projects are growing faster.
parts.SIZE: One of the world's larger makers of cryogenic storage equipment and India's leading one, part of the INOX Group.
parts.RIVALS: Chart Industries, Linde Engineering, Air Liquide's Cryolor and Wessington Cryogenics in cryogenic equipment.
parts.WATCH: Watch its new Kandla facility, orders from space companies and LNG trucking, and its push into overseas markets.

quiz.prompt: What does INOX India mainly make?
Which company competes with INOX India?
Which new facility is INOX India building?

companies.note_30w: INOX India makes cryogenic tanks for LNG, industrial gases and space projects. Industrial gas equipment leads; watch its Kandla facility and overseas growth.

companies.name: IRB Infrastructure Developers

parts.SELLS: IRB builds and runs toll roads across India, including the Mumbai-Pune Expressway. It wins highways under build-operate-transfer and toll-operate-transfer contracts and moves finished roads into its infrastructure trusts (InvITs).
parts.EARNS: It earns tolls from vehicles on roads it runs, construction income from building highways for its InvITs and fees for managing those trusts. Toll collection is the steadiest part of its income.
parts.SIZE: One of India's largest private toll road developers and operators, with roads spread across many states.
parts.RIVALS: Cube Highways, Ashoka Buildcon, PNC Infratech and Dilip Buildcon in highway building and toll operations.
parts.WATCH: Watch NHAI's toll-operate-transfer bundles it bids for, how it moves more roads into its InvITs, and the effect of the annual FASTag pass introduced in 2025.

quiz.prompt: Which famous road does IRB run?
What is IRB's steadiest source of income?
Which company is a rival to IRB?

companies.note_30w: IRB builds and runs toll roads, including the Mumbai-Pune Expressway, earning tolls and construction income. Watch NHAI toll bundles and moving roads into InvITs.

companies.name: ITC Hotels

parts.SELLS: ITC Hotels runs luxury and upscale hotels under brands such as ITC Hotels, Mementos, Welcomhotel, Storii, Fortune and WelcomHeritage. It was demerged from ITC and listed in January 2025, with ITC keeping a large minority stake.
parts.EARNS: It earns from room rents, food and banquets at hotels it owns, and fees from hotels it manages for other owners. Its owned luxury hotels in big cities bring in most of the revenue and profit.
parts.SIZE: One of India's largest hotel chains and a leader in luxury hotels, alongside Taj and Oberoi.
parts.RIVALS: Indian Hotels (Taj), EIH (Oberoi), The Leela, Chalet Hotels and global chains such as Marriott and Hyatt.
parts.WATCH: Watch its plan to grow mainly by managing hotels owned by others rather than building its own, new openings including in Kerala, and demand from weddings and business travel.

quiz.prompt: Which brand belongs to ITC Hotels?
When did ITC Hotels list after its demerger?
Which is a direct rival of ITC Hotels?

companies.note_30w: ITC Hotels runs luxury brands like ITC Hotels, Welcomhotel and Fortune. Demerged from ITC in January 2025, it now grows mainly by managing others' hotels.

companies.name: ITI Ltd

parts.SELLS: Government-owned ITI, set up in 1948, makes telecom equipment and builds networks. It installs rural broadband under BharatNet, supplies and sets up 4G sites for BSNL, builds secure networks for defence and makes electronics such as smart meters.
parts.EARNS: It earns from government network projects and equipment orders, mostly from BSNL, BharatNet and defence. Network installation projects bring in most of its revenue, while its own manufacturing is smaller.
parts.SIZE: India's oldest public sector company and a small telecom equipment maker next to global vendors, kept busy mainly by government projects.
parts.RIVALS: Tejas Networks, HFCL and Sterlite Technologies (STL) in Indian telecom gear and network projects, plus global vendors such as Nokia.
parts.WATCH: Watch execution of its BharatNet Phase III projects and its 2026 BSNL 4G order, and whether it can stay profitable after years of losses.

quiz.prompt: Which customer gives ITI many network orders?
Which company is a rival to ITI?
Which rural broadband programme should you watch for ITI?

companies.note_30w: Government-owned ITI builds telecom networks and equipment, mainly for BSNL, BharatNet and defence. Watch BharatNet Phase III, BSNL 4G work and staying profitable.

companies.name: IndiaMART

parts.SELLS: IndiaMART runs an online marketplace where businesses find suppliers of products from machinery to chemicals. Buyers use it free; small and mid-sized sellers pay subscriptions to list products and get buyer leads. It also owns Busy accounting software.
parts.EARNS: Most revenue comes from annual subscriptions paid by sellers for better listings and more buyer leads. Paid subscriptions are collected upfront, which gives it strong cash flow.
parts.SIZE: India's largest online business-to-business marketplace, with by far the most supplier listings in the country.
parts.RIVALS: TradeIndia, Udaan, Justdial and global platforms such as Alibaba.com.
parts.WATCH: Watch growth in paying suppliers and how many leave each year, its use of AI to match buyers and sellers, and growth at Busy.

quiz.prompt: Who pays IndiaMART most of its revenue?
Which accounting software does IndiaMART own?
Which is a rival to IndiaMART?

companies.note_30w: IndiaMART runs India's largest online business marketplace, earning upfront subscriptions from sellers. It also owns Busy accounting software. Watch paying-supplier growth.

companies.name: Indian Bank

parts.SELLS: Government-owned Indian Bank offers deposits, home, gold, farm and business loans through a large network concentrated in south India. It absorbed Allahabad Bank in 2020, which gave it a strong base in north and east India too.
parts.EARNS: It earns the gap between interest on loans and what it pays depositors, plus fees. Retail, agriculture and small business loans make up a large and profitable part of its book.
parts.SIZE: One of India's larger public sector banks and among the biggest lenders in Tamil Nadu.
parts.RIVALS: Canara Bank, Indian Overseas Bank, Bank of Baroda and Union Bank of India, plus private banks such as HDFC Bank.
parts.WATCH: Watch its deposit growth against private banks, its digital banking push and the health of its loan book.

quiz.prompt: Which bank merged into Indian Bank in 2020?
Where is Indian Bank's network concentrated?
Which bank is a rival to Indian Bank?

companies.note_30w: Government-owned Indian Bank, Chennai-based, absorbed Allahabad Bank in 2020. It earns mainly from retail, farm and small business loans across a strong southern network.

companies.name: Indian Energy Exchange (IEX)

parts.SELLS: IEX runs India's main electricity exchange, where power producers, utilities and large companies buy and sell power for the next day, in real time or for longer terms. It also runs green power and renewable energy certificate markets, and its group includes Indian Gas Exchange.
parts.EARNS: It earns a small fee on every unit of electricity traded, charged to both buyer and seller. The day-ahead and real-time markets bring in most of its income.
parts.SIZE: India's dominant power exchange, handling most of the electricity traded on exchanges in the country.
parts.RIVALS: Power Exchange India (PXIL) and Hindustan Power Exchange (HPX), plus long-term power contracts signed directly between producers and utilities.
parts.WATCH: Watch the power regulator CERC's move to couple prices across power exchanges, which could weaken IEX's edge, and growth in green power trading.

quiz.prompt: What does IEX charge to make money?
Which is a rival power exchange?
Which regulator's market coupling plan should you watch?

companies.note_30w: IEX runs India's dominant electricity exchange, earning a fee on every unit traded. Watch CERC's market coupling plan and growth in green power trading.

companies.name: Indian Overseas Bank

parts.SELLS: Government-owned Indian Overseas Bank (IOB) offers deposits, retail, farm and business loans, with a large network in Tamil Nadu and a few branches abroad. It was founded in 1937 to serve overseas trade.
parts.EARNS: It earns the gap between interest on loans and what it pays depositors, plus fees. Retail, agriculture and small business loans are now the core of its book after years of cutting corporate exposure.
parts.SIZE: A mid-sized public sector bank with a strong base in south India. It exited RBI's prompt corrective action framework in 2021 after a long clean-up.
parts.RIVALS: Indian Bank, Central Bank of India, UCO Bank and Bank of Maharashtra, plus private banks such as Karur Vysya Bank in Tamil Nadu.
parts.WATCH: The government owns almost all of IOB and must cut its stake to meet public shareholding rules. Shareholders approved an equity raise in 2026, and the MD's term was extended to October 2027.

quiz.prompt: When did IOB exit RBI's prompt corrective action framework?
Why must IOB raise equity?
Which bank is a rival to IOB?

companies.note_30w: Indian Overseas Bank is a Chennai-based public sector bank, cleaned up after RBI curbs. Watch equity raising to cut the government's very high stake.

companies.name: IREDA

parts.SELLS: Indian Renewable Energy Development Agency (IREDA) is a government-owned lender that funds solar, wind, hydro, green hydrogen, battery storage and electric mobility projects. It listed in November 2023.
parts.EARNS: It earns the gap between interest on project loans and its borrowing costs. Loans to solar and wind projects make up most of its book.
parts.SIZE: India's largest specialist lender to renewable energy and a Navratna public sector company.
parts.RIVALS: Power Finance Corporation, REC, State Bank of India and private lenders such as Tata Capital in green energy loans.
parts.WATCH: Its CMD retired in June 2026 and Director (Finance) Bijay Kumar Mohanty holds additional charge until a regular head is appointed. Also watch its new green finance arm at GIFT City and the quality of its loans.

quiz.prompt: What does IREDA mainly fund?
Which is a rival lender to IREDA?
What leadership change should you watch at IREDA?

companies.note_30w: Government-owned IREDA is India's largest specialist renewable energy lender, mostly to solar and wind. Watch the appointment of a regular CMD and loan quality.

companies.name: Indraprastha Gas (IGL)

parts.SELLS: IGL supplies CNG to vehicles and piped natural gas (PNG) to homes, shops and factories in Delhi NCR and other cities. It is promoted by GAIL and BPCL.
parts.EARNS: It earns a margin between the cost of gas it buys and the price it charges. CNG for buses, autos, taxis and cars in Delhi NCR is its biggest and most profitable business.
parts.SIZE: One of India's largest city gas distribution companies and the main CNG supplier in the national capital.
parts.RIVALS: Mahanagar Gas, Adani Total Gas, Gujarat Gas and Torrent Gas, plus petrol, diesel and electric vehicles competing with CNG.
parts.WATCH: Kumar Shanker became MD in June 2026. Watch government cuts to cheap domestic gas supplies, the shift to electric buses and cars in Delhi, and its growth in new cities.

quiz.prompt: What is IGL's biggest business?
Which company is a rival to IGL?
What long-term threat to CNG demand should you watch?

companies.note_30w: IGL supplies CNG and piped gas mainly in Delhi NCR, earning a margin on gas. Watch domestic gas allocation and the shift to electric vehicles.

companies.name: Intellect Design Arena

parts.SELLS: Intellect sells software to banks and insurers: core banking, transaction banking (iGTB), lending, wealth and insurance platforms, all built on its eMACH.ai platform. It also offers Purple Fabric, an AI platform for enterprises. Customers are banks worldwide.
parts.EARNS: It earns licence fees, implementation charges and recurring maintenance and subscription fees. Licence and platform deals with large banks drive its growth, and recurring fees give it a steady base.
parts.SIZE: One of India's leading banking software product companies, with clients across many countries.
parts.RIVALS: Infosys Finacle, TCS BaNCS, Temenos, Oracle Financial Services and Nucleus Software.
parts.WATCH: Watch large bank deals it signs, uptake of Purple Fabric and its eMACH.ai platform, and growth in recurring subscription revenue.

quiz.prompt: What is Intellect's AI platform for enterprises called?
Which company is a rival to Intellect?
What gives Intellect a steady base of income?

companies.note_30w: Intellect sells banking and insurance software built on eMACH.ai, plus the Purple Fabric AI platform. It earns licences and recurring fees from banks worldwide.

companies.name: International Gemological Institute (IGI)

parts.SELLS: IGI grades and certifies diamonds, lab-grown diamonds, coloured gemstones and jewellery, and runs gemology courses. Jewellers, diamond makers and retailers send stones for reports that buyers trust. It listed in December 2024 and is controlled by Blackstone.
parts.EARNS: It earns a fee for each stone or piece certified. Lab-grown diamond certification has become its fastest-growing and largest business, alongside natural diamonds and studded jewellery.
parts.SIZE: One of the world's largest gem certification labs and the leader in grading lab-grown diamonds.
parts.RIVALS: Gemological Institute of America (GIA), HRD Antwerp, Solitaire Gemmological Laboratories and Gemological Science International (GSI).
parts.WATCH: Watch demand for lab-grown diamonds, US tariffs on Indian diamond and jewellery exports, and new labs it opens abroad.

quiz.prompt: What does IGI mainly sell?
Which is IGI's biggest global rival?
Which business has driven IGI's growth?

companies.note_30w: IGI grades diamonds, lab-grown stones and jewellery, earning a fee per piece. Lab-grown certification drives growth; watch US tariffs on Indian diamond exports.

companies.name: Inventurus Knowledge Solutions (IKS)

parts.SELLS: IKS handles back-office and clinical support work for US doctors and hospital groups: medical billing and revenue cycle management, clinical documentation and care management. It acquired AQuity Solutions in 2024 and listed in December 2024.
parts.EARNS: It earns fees from healthcare providers for running their billing, documentation and care tasks. Almost all revenue comes from US clients, with revenue cycle work and clinical documentation the largest parts.
parts.SIZE: One of India's larger healthcare services outsourcing firms, focused on US physician groups and health systems.
parts.RIVALS: R1 RCM, Omega Healthcare, AGS Health and Access Healthcare, plus in-house teams at US hospitals.
parts.WATCH: Watch how it integrates AQuity, its use of AI for documentation and billing, and changes in US healthcare spending.

quiz.prompt: Where do almost all of IKS's clients sit?
Which company did IKS acquire in 2024?
Which company is a rival to IKS?

companies.note_30w: IKS runs billing, documentation and care management for US doctors and hospitals. It bought AQuity in 2024; watch integration and AI-driven automation.

companies.name: Ipca Laboratories

parts.SELLS: Ipca makes branded medicines for India, generics for export and active ingredients (APIs). Its well-known brands include Zerodol for pain and Lariago and HCQS for malaria and arthritis. It holds a controlling stake in Unichem Laboratories.
parts.EARNS: It earns mostly from branded medicines sold to Indian doctors and pharmacies, where pain management is its biggest therapy. Exports of generics and APIs add the rest.
parts.SIZE: A mid-sized Indian pharma company and one of the leaders in pain management and anti-malarial medicines in India.
parts.RIVALS: Sun Pharma, Torrent Pharma, Alkem Laboratories and Cipla in Indian branded medicines.
parts.WATCH: Watch US FDA inspections of its plants, integration of Unichem, and growth of its Indian brands in pain and heart care.

quiz.prompt: Which therapy is Ipca's biggest in India?
Which company does Ipca hold a controlling stake in?
Which company is a rival to Ipca?

companies.note_30w: Ipca sells branded medicines like Zerodol and Lariago in India plus generics and APIs abroad. Pain management leads; watch FDA inspections and Unichem integration.

companies.name: JK Cement

parts.SELLS: JK Cement makes grey cement for builders and homeowners and white cement and wall putty under JK White. It has also entered paints with JK Maxx Paints and makes tile adhesives.
parts.EARNS: Grey cement brings in most of its revenue, while white cement and wall putty earn higher margins. Its plants in Rajasthan, Madhya Pradesh and the south supply north, central and southern markets.
parts.SIZE: One of India's larger cement makers and one of the two leading white cement makers in India, alongside UltraTech's Birla White.
parts.RIVALS: UltraTech (including Birla White), Shree Cement, Ambuja Cements and Dalmia Bharat.
parts.WATCH: Watch its announced capacity expansions in central and eastern India and whether its young paints business gains ground.

quiz.prompt: What is JK Cement's white cement brand?
Which JK Cement products earn higher margins?
Which company is a rival to JK Cement?

companies.note_30w: JK Cement sells grey cement plus higher-margin JK White cement and putty, and has entered paints. Watch its expansion into central and eastern India.

companies.name: JBM Auto

parts.SELLS: JBM Auto makes sheet metal parts and assemblies for carmakers, builds tooling and dies, and makes electric buses under JBM Ecolife for city and state transport agencies.
parts.EARNS: Components for car and two-wheeler makers bring in a large, steady share of revenue. Electric buses, often run under long-term contracts with state transport agencies, are its fastest-growing business.
parts.SIZE: One of India's leading electric bus makers and a sizeable auto components supplier.
parts.RIVALS: Olectra Greentech, PMI Electro Mobility, Switch Mobility and Tata Motors in electric buses, plus other sheet metal parts makers.
parts.WATCH: Watch electric bus orders under the government's PM e-Bus Sewa and PM E-DRIVE schemes, its expanding bus factories, and payments from state transport agencies.

quiz.prompt: What is JBM Auto's electric bus brand?
Which company competes with JBM Auto in electric buses?
Which government scheme drives JBM's bus orders?

companies.note_30w: JBM Auto makes sheet metal car parts and JBM Ecolife electric buses. E-buses grow fastest; watch PM e-Bus Sewa orders and state payments.

companies.name: JK Tyre & Industries

parts.SELLS: JK Tyre makes tyres for trucks, buses, cars, two-wheelers and tractors, selling to vehicle makers and through dealers. It owns Cavendish Industries in India and JK Tornel in Mexico.
parts.EARNS: Most revenue comes from replacement tyres sold through dealers, which earn better margins than tyres supplied to vehicle makers. Truck and bus radial tyres are its largest segment.
parts.SIZE: One of India's top tyre makers and a leader in truck and bus radial tyres.
parts.RIVALS: MRF, Apollo Tyres, CEAT and Bridgestone India.
parts.WATCH: Watch natural rubber and crude-linked raw material costs, its capacity expansions and its exports to the US and Europe.

quiz.prompt: Which is JK Tyre's largest segment?
Where is JK Tyre's subsidiary JK Tornel based?
Which company is a rival to JK Tyre?

companies.note_30w: JK Tyre makes tyres for trucks, cars and two-wheelers, leading in truck and bus radials. Replacement sales earn most; watch rubber costs and exports.

companies.name: JM Financial

parts.SELLS: JM Financial is a financial services group advising companies on IPOs, mergers and fundraising, wealth management, stock broking, asset management and loans including home loans and loans to developers.
parts.EARNS: It earns fees from managing IPOs, mergers and fundraising, plus broking and wealth fees, and interest from its lending arms. Deal advisory and wealth are its most profitable businesses.
parts.SIZE: One of India's leading deal advisers and among the most active managers of IPOs.
parts.RIVALS: Kotak Mahindra Capital, Axis Capital, ICICI Securities, IIFL Capital and Motilal Oswal.
parts.WATCH: Watch the IPO and deal pipeline, its scaling down of wholesale real estate lending, and growth in wealth management.

quiz.prompt: What is JM Financial best known for?
Which is a rival to JM Financial?
Which of its businesses is it scaling down?

companies.note_30w: JM Financial is a leading Indian IPO and deal adviser also offering wealth, broking and loans. Watch the IPO pipeline and its shift away from wholesale real estate lending.

companies.name: JSW Cement

parts.SELLS: JSW Cement, part of the JSW Group, makes cement and ground granulated blast furnace slag (GGBS), a green cement substitute made from steel plant slag. It sells to builders, infrastructure projects and retail buyers, and listed in August 2025.
parts.EARNS: It earns from cement and slag products sold through dealers and to large projects. Using slag from JSW Steel plants lowers its costs and carbon footprint, and blended cement is most of its sales.
parts.SIZE: India's largest maker of GGBS and one of the country's mid-sized cement companies, with plants in the south, west and east.
parts.RIVALS: UltraTech, Ambuja Cements, Shree Cement and Dalmia Bharat.
parts.WATCH: Watch its announced new plant in Rajasthan to enter north India, its expansion plans after listing, and cement prices in its southern markets.

quiz.prompt: What green product is JSW Cement India's largest maker of?
When did JSW Cement list?
Which company is a rival to JSW Cement?

companies.note_30w: JSW Cement makes cement and green slag cement using JSW Steel slag. Listed in August 2025, it is expanding into north India with a Rajasthan plant.

companies.name: JSW Infrastructure

parts.SELLS: JSW Infrastructure runs ports and terminals that handle coal, iron ore, steel, containers and liquids, including Jaigarh and Dharamtar in Maharashtra and terminals at Paradip, Ennore and Mangalore and in the UAE. It also owns Navkar Corporation for rail logistics.
parts.EARNS: It earns cargo handling and storage fees. Much of its cargo comes from JSW Group companies such as JSW Steel and JSW Energy, though third-party cargo is growing.
parts.SIZE: India's second-largest private commercial port operator after Adani Ports.
parts.RIVALS: Adani Ports, government-run major ports and terminal operators such as DP World and JM Baxi.
parts.WATCH: Watch its announced new ports on the Maharashtra and Karnataka coasts, growth in rail and logistics, and its effort to win more cargo from outside the JSW Group.

quiz.prompt: Where does much of JSW Infrastructure's cargo come from?
Which is India's largest private port operator, ahead of JSW?
Which rail logistics firm does JSW Infrastructure own?

companies.note_30w: JSW Infrastructure runs ports like Jaigarh and terminals across India, mostly handling JSW Group cargo. India's second-largest private port operator, expanding ports and rail logistics.

companies.name: Jain Resource Recycling

parts.SELLS: Jain Resource Recycling recycles scrap lead, copper and aluminium into metal and alloys. Battery makers buy its lead and cable and wire makers buy its copper, in India and abroad. It listed in October 2025.
parts.EARNS: It earns a margin between the cost of scrap and the price of recycled metal, which tracks global metal prices. Recycled lead for batteries is its largest product.
parts.SIZE: One of India's largest non-ferrous metal recyclers, with a strong export business.
parts.RIVALS: Gravita India, Pondy Oxides and Chemicals and Nile Ltd in lead and metal recycling.
parts.WATCH: Watch India's battery waste rules that push makers to use recycled lead, its plant expansions and swings in global metal prices.

quiz.prompt: Who mainly buys Jain Resource Recycling's lead?
Which company is a rival recycler?
Which rules could lift demand for recycled lead?

companies.note_30w: Jain Resource Recycling turns scrap lead, copper and aluminium into metal for battery and cable makers. Listed in October 2025; watch battery waste rules.

companies.name: Jaiprakash Power Ventures (JP Power)

parts.SELLS: JP Power generates electricity from thermal plants at Nigrie and Bina in Madhya Pradesh and the Vishnuprayag hydro plant in Uttarakhand, and mines coal for its own use. It sells power to state utilities and on power exchanges.
parts.EARNS: It earns from selling electricity under long-term contracts with state utilities and on exchanges. The Jaypee Nigrie thermal plant, fed by its own coal mine, brings in most of its revenue.
parts.SIZE: A mid-sized private power producer, far smaller than NTPC, Adani Power or Tata Power.
parts.RIVALS: NTPC, Tata Power, JSW Energy and Adani Power in power generation.
parts.WATCH: Adani Power bought a large stake in 2026 from the insolvent Jaiprakash Associates, and the board and top management were replaced. Watch who leads it and how the new owner runs its plants.

quiz.prompt: Where is JP Power's Nigrie thermal plant?
Which company bought a large stake in JP Power in 2026?
Which plant brings in most of JP Power's revenue?

companies.note_30w: JP Power runs thermal and hydro plants in Madhya Pradesh and Uttarakhand. Adani Power bought a large stake in 2026; watch the new management.

companies.name: J&K Bank

parts.SELLS: Jammu & Kashmir Bank offers deposits, home, personal, business and government banking. It is majority-owned by the Jammu and Kashmir government and acts as the banker to the union territory's government.
parts.EARNS: It earns the gap between interest on loans and what it pays depositors. Low-cost deposits from government and households in Jammu and Kashmir and retail loans there make up most of its business.
parts.SIZE: The dominant bank in Jammu and Kashmir and Ladakh, though a mid-sized bank nationally.
parts.RIVALS: State Bank of India, HDFC Bank, Punjab National Bank and J&K Grameen Bank in its home region.
parts.WATCH: Watch its plans to grow loans outside Jammu and Kashmir, the health of its loan book and the region's economy and tourism.

quiz.prompt: Who majority-owns J&K Bank?
Which bank competes with J&K Bank in its home region?
What growth plan should you watch at J&K Bank?

companies.note_30w: J&K Bank, majority-owned by the Jammu and Kashmir government, dominates banking in J&K and Ladakh. Watch lending growth outside its home region.

companies.name: Jindal Saw

parts.SELLS: Jindal Saw makes steel pipes: large-diameter pipes for oil and gas pipelines, ductile iron pipes for water supply and sewage, and seamless and stainless pipes. Buyers include oil and gas companies, water boards and city agencies in India and abroad.
parts.EARNS: It earns by selling pipes, mostly against project orders. Ductile iron pipes for water projects and large-diameter pipes for pipelines bring in most of its revenue.
parts.SIZE: One of India's largest steel pipe makers and among the world's large makers of ductile iron pipes.
parts.RIVALS: Welspun Corp, Electrosteel Castings, Maharashtra Seamless and Ratnamani Metals and Tubes.
parts.WATCH: Watch orders tied to the Jal Jeevan Mission water programme, pipeline projects in India and the Middle East, and US tariffs on steel imports.

quiz.prompt: What are Jindal Saw's ductile iron pipes used for?
Which company is a rival to Jindal Saw?
Which water programme drives Jindal Saw's orders?

companies.note_30w: Jindal Saw makes steel pipes for oil and gas pipelines and ductile iron pipes for water. Watch Jal Jeevan Mission orders and US steel tariffs.

companies.name: Jindal Stainless

parts.SELLS: Jindal Stainless makes stainless steel slabs, coils, sheets and strips at plants in Jajpur, Odisha and Hisar, Haryana. Buyers include makers of kitchenware, pipes, railway coaches, cars, appliances and building products.
parts.EARNS: It earns by selling stainless steel, with margins shaped by nickel and chrome prices and import competition. Flat products sold in India bring in most of its revenue, with exports adding the rest.
parts.SIZE: India's largest stainless steel maker and one of the larger producers outside China.
parts.RIVALS: Steel Authority of India's Salem plant, Viraj Profiles and cheap imports from China, Indonesia and Vietnam.
parts.WATCH: Watch its capacity expansion at Jajpur, its nickel venture in Indonesia, and anti-dumping duties on imported stainless steel.

Which raw material price strongly affects its margins?
Which policy should you watch for Jindal Stainless?

companies.note_30w: Jindal Stainless is India's largest stainless steel maker, with plants in Odisha and Haryana. Watch Jajpur expansion, Indonesian nickel and duties on cheap imports.

companies.name: Jubilant Ingrevia

parts.SELLS: Jubilant Ingrevia makes speciality chemicals such as pyridines used in medicines and crop protection, nutrition products such as vitamin B3 and choline chloride for animal feed, and chemicals like acetic anhydride. It was demerged from Jubilant Life Sciences in 2021.
parts.EARNS: It earns by selling chemicals and doing contract manufacturing for pharma and agrochemical companies. Speciality chemicals are its most profitable segment, while chemical intermediates are larger but lower margin.
parts.SIZE: One of the world's largest makers of pyridine and its derivatives and a leading Indian speciality chemicals company.
parts.RIVALS: Vertellus and Lonza globally, and Laxmi Organic Industries and Aarti Industries in India.
parts.WATCH: Watch new contract manufacturing deals with global pharma and crop-science firms, its capacity additions and competition from Chinese chemical makers.

quiz.prompt: Which chemical family is Jubilant Ingrevia a world leader in?
Which is Jubilant Ingrevia's most profitable segment?
Which company is a rival to Jubilant Ingrevia?

companies.note_30w: Jubilant Ingrevia, demerged in 2021, makes pyridines, vitamins and chemical intermediates. Speciality chemicals earn most; watch contract manufacturing deals and Chinese competition.

companies.name: Jupiter Wagons

parts.SELLS: Jupiter Wagons makes railway freight wagons, wagon parts and brake systems, plus load bodies for trucks and electric light commercial vehicles. Its main customer is Indian Railways, along with private wagon owners and exporters.
parts.EARNS: It earns by building wagons against orders, mostly from Indian Railways. Wagon building is its largest business, while brakes, wheels and parts add higher-margin income.
parts.SIZE: One of India's leading freight wagon makers.
parts.RIVALS: Titagarh Rail Systems, Texmaco Rail and Engineering and BEML in rail rolling stock.
parts.WATCH: Watch Indian Railways wagon orders, its wheel and axle plant in Odisha, and growth of its electric vehicle unit.

companies.note_30w: Jupiter Wagons builds freight wagons, brakes and truck bodies, mostly for Indian Railways. Watch railway orders and its wheel and axle plant in Odisha.

companies.name: Jyoti CNC Automation

parts.SELLS: Jyoti CNC makes computer-controlled (CNC) machine tools such as turning centres and multi-axis machining centres, and owns the French brand Huron. Buyers include aerospace, defence, auto parts, electronics and general engineering firms. It listed in January 2024.
parts.EARNS: It earns by selling machines and spare parts. Customers in aerospace and defence buy its higher-end machines, and Huron adds sales in Europe.
parts.SIZE: One of India's largest makers of CNC machine tools.
parts.RIVALS: Ace Micromatic, Bharat Fritz Werner and global makers such as DMG Mori, Mazak and Haas.
parts.WATCH: Watch its factory expansion in Rajkot, orders from aerospace and defence makers, and demand for machine tools from auto and electronics plants.

Which company competes with Jyoti CNC?
Which customers buy Jyoti CNC's higher-end machines?

companies.note_30w: Jyoti CNC makes CNC machine tools and owns France's Huron, selling to aerospace, defence and auto firms. Watch its Rajkot expansion and defence orders.

companies.name: KPR Mill

parts.SELLS: KPR Mill makes yarn, fabric and ready-made garments, mostly knitted wear exported to global fashion retailers. It also sells innerwear under its FASO brand and makes sugar and ethanol.
parts.EARNS: Garments for export bring in the largest and most profitable share of revenue, helped by owning every step from cotton to finished clothes. Yarn, fabric and sugar add the rest.
parts.SIZE: One of India's largest vertically integrated garment makers and garment exporters.
parts.RIVALS: Gokaldas Exports, Arvind, Welspun Living, Vardhman Textiles and Trident.
parts.WATCH: Watch the India-UK trade deal, US tariffs on Indian garments, and the growth of its FASO brand in Indian stores.

Which business earns KPR Mill the most?
Which company is a rival to KPR Mill?

companies.note_30w: KPR Mill makes yarn, fabric and export garments, plus FASO innerwear and sugar. Garments earn most; watch the India-UK trade deal and US tariffs.

companies.name: KEI Industries

parts.SELLS: KEI makes power cables, extra-high-voltage cables, control cables and house wires. It sells to power utilities, infrastructure projects, factories and homebuyers through dealers, and exports to many countries.
parts.EARNS: Cables for power, industrial and infrastructure projects bring in most of its revenue. Retail house wires sold through dealers are growing and earn steady margins.
parts.SIZE: One of India's top cable and wire makers and a leader in extra-high-voltage cables.
parts.RIVALS: Polycab, Havells, RR Kabel, Finolex Cables and UltraTech, which entered cables and wires in 2025.
parts.WATCH: Watch the ramp-up of its new Sanand plant in Gujarat, its retail growth, and the new competition from UltraTech.

Which KEI segment brings in most revenue?

companies.note_30w: KEI makes power cables, extra-high-voltage cables and house wires. Project cables earn most; watch its Sanand plant and UltraTech's entry into cables.

companies.name: KSB Ltd

parts.SELLS: KSB makes pumps and valves for power plants, nuclear plants, water supply, oil and gas, buildings and farms, including solar pumps. It is the Indian arm of Germany's KSB SE.
parts.EARNS: It earns from selling pumps, valves and spare parts and from servicing them. Pumps bring in most of its revenue, while nuclear and power projects are higher-value orders.
parts.SIZE: One of India's leading pump and valve makers and a key supplier of pumps for nuclear power plants.
parts.RIVALS: Kirloskar Brothers, Grundfos, Xylem, CRI Pumps and Shakti Pumps.
parts.WATCH: Rajeev Jain was re-appointed MD until 2031. Watch nuclear power orders, solar pump demand under PM-KUSUM, and the weak valves business.

Which farm scheme drives KSB's solar pump demand?

companies.note_30w: KSB, the Indian arm of Germany's KSB SE, makes pumps and valves for power, nuclear, water and farms. Watch nuclear orders and PM-KUSUM solar pumps.

companies.name: Kajaria Ceramics

parts.SELLS: Kajaria makes ceramic and vitrified tiles for floors and walls, plus bathroom fittings and sanitaryware under Kerovit and tile adhesives. It sells to homeowners, builders and architects through dealers and showrooms.
parts.EARNS: Tiles bring in most of its revenue and profit, sold through a wide dealer network. Founder Ashok Kajaria is chairman and his son Rishi Kajaria is MD. Bathware and adhesives are smaller but growing.
parts.SIZE: India's largest maker of ceramic and vitrified tiles.
parts.RIVALS: Somany Ceramics, Asian Granito, Orient Bell, Prism Johnson's H&R Johnson and many low-cost makers in Morbi, Gujarat.
parts.WATCH: Watch price competition from Morbi tile makers, gas costs for its kilns, and growth of its bathware business.

Which product brings Kajaria most of its revenue?

companies.note_30w: Kajaria is India's largest tile maker, also selling Kerovit bathware and adhesives. Tiles earn most; watch Morbi price competition and gas costs.

companies.name: Kalpataru Projects International

parts.SELLS: Kalpataru Projects builds power transmission lines and substations, buildings and factories, water projects, railways, oil and gas pipelines and urban infrastructure, in India and abroad. It merged with JMC Projects in 2023 and took its current name.
parts.EARNS: It earns by executing engineering, procurement and construction contracts. Power transmission and distribution is its largest and most established business, with buildings and water close behind.
parts.SIZE: One of India's largest power transmission EPC companies, with projects across many countries and subsidiaries such as Linjemontage in Sweden and Fasttel in Brazil.
parts.RIVALS: KEC International, Larsen & Toubro, Tata Projects and Sterling and Wilson.
parts.WATCH: Watch transmission orders tied to renewable energy, its exit from road assets, and payments on water projects from state governments.

quiz.prompt: Which company merged into Kalpataru Projects in 2023?
Which is Kalpataru's largest business?
Which company is a rival to Kalpataru?

companies.note_30w: Kalpataru Projects builds power transmission lines, buildings, water and rail projects worldwide. It merged with JMC in 2023; watch transmission orders and road asset exits.

companies.name: Karur Vysya Bank

parts.SELLS: Karur Vysya Bank, founded in 1916, offers deposits, jewel loans, home and vehicle loans, and loans to small businesses and traders, mostly in Tamil Nadu and nearby states.
parts.EARNS: It earns the gap between interest on loans and what it pays depositors, plus fees. Gold-backed jewel loans and small business loans are a large, profitable part of its book.
parts.SIZE: A mid-sized old private sector bank and one of the leading banks in Tamil Nadu.
parts.RIVALS: City Union Bank, Tamilnad Mercantile Bank, South Indian Bank and Federal Bank.
parts.WATCH: B. Ramesh Babu began a third term as MD and CEO in July 2026, and the bank named a new COO and CFO. Watch loan growth and gold loan rules.

companies.note_30w: Karur Vysya Bank is an old private bank strong in Tamil Nadu, with jewel and small business loans. Its MD began a third term in July 2026.

companies.name: KEC International

parts.SELLS: KEC International, part of the RPG Group, builds power transmission lines and substations, railways, civil and factory buildings, renewable energy plants, oil and gas pipelines, and makes cables. It works in India, the Middle East, Africa and the Americas.
parts.EARNS: It earns by executing engineering, procurement and construction contracts. Power transmission and distribution is its largest business, with civil construction the fastest growing.
parts.SIZE: One of the world's larger power transmission EPC companies and among India's top infrastructure contractors.
parts.RIVALS: Kalpataru Projects International, Larsen & Toubro, Tata Projects and Sterling and Wilson.
parts.WATCH: Watch transmission orders in India and the Middle East, progress on its civil construction business and margins on fixed-price contracts.

quiz.prompt: Which business group does KEC belong to?
Which is KEC's largest business?
Which company is a rival to KEC?

companies.note_30w: KEC International, an RPG Group firm, builds power transmission lines, railways and buildings worldwide. Transmission leads; watch orders and fixed-price contract margins.

companies.name: KFin Technologies

parts.SELLS: KFin Technologies keeps records and processes transactions for mutual funds, companies and pension systems. It serves fund houses as a registrar, handles shareholder records and IPOs for companies, and is a record-keeper for the National Pension System.
parts.EARNS: It earns fees from fund houses based on assets and transactions, and from companies and pension schemes. Mutual fund services bring in most of its revenue.
parts.SIZE: One of India's two big mutual fund registrars, serving more fund houses than any rival.
parts.RIVALS: Computer Age Management Services (CAMS) in mutual funds, MUFG Intime (formerly Link Intime) in company registry, and Protean eGov in pensions.

Which firm did KFin buy to grow abroad?

companies.note_30w: KFin Technologies is a registrar for mutual funds, companies and pensions, earning fees on assets and transactions. Watch its global expansion after buying Ascent.

companies.name: Kirloskar Brothers

parts.SELLS: Kirloskar Brothers makes pumps and valves for farms, homes, buildings, industry, power plants and large irrigation and water projects. It also owns SPP Pumps in the UK and has subsidiaries in several countries.
parts.EARNS: It earns by selling pumps and valves through dealers and to projects. Industrial and project pumps bring in most of its revenue, while farm and home pumps sell through retail channels.
parts.SIZE: India's largest maker of centrifugal pumps and one of the oldest engineering companies in the country.
parts.RIVALS: KSB, Grundfos, Crompton Greaves Consumer, CRI Pumps and Shakti Pumps.
parts.WATCH: Watch irrigation and water project orders, growth in overseas subsidiaries, and the long-running family legal dispute within the Kirloskar group.

quiz.prompt: Which UK pump maker does Kirloskar Brothers own?
What is Kirloskar Brothers known as in India?
Which company is a rival to Kirloskar Brothers?

companies.note_30w: Kirloskar Brothers is India's largest centrifugal pump maker, serving farms, homes, industry and water projects. Watch project orders and the Kirloskar family legal dispute.

companies.name: Kirloskar Oil Engines

parts.SELLS: Kirloskar Oil Engines makes diesel engines and generator sets under the Kirloskar Green brand, engines for farm pumps, tractors and construction machinery, and engines for defence and railways. Its group also includes the lender Arka Fincap.
parts.EARNS: Power generation, mainly diesel gensets for buildings, data centres and industry, brings in the largest share of revenue. Industrial engines and farm equipment add the rest, with Arka Fincap earning interest.
parts.SIZE: One of India's leading makers of diesel engines and generator sets.
parts.RIVALS: Cummins India, Mahindra Powerol, Ashok Leyland's Leypower and Greaves Cotton.
parts.WATCH: Watch its push to sell engines in the US and other export markets, demand from data centres, and growth at Arka Fincap.

Which company competes with Kirloskar Oil Engines?
Which lender is part of the Kirloskar Oil Engines group?

companies.note_30w: Kirloskar Oil Engines makes Kirloskar Green gensets and engines for farms, industry and defence. Power generation leads; watch exports and data centre demand.

companies.name: KIMS Hospitals

parts.SELLS: KIMS runs multi-specialty hospitals under the KIMS brand in Telangana, Andhra Pradesh, Maharashtra and Karnataka, treating heart, cancer, kidney, brain and transplant cases.
parts.EARNS: It earns from treatments, surgeries, room charges, tests and pharmacy sales. Hospitals in Telangana and Andhra Pradesh bring in most of its revenue and profit.
parts.SIZE: One of India's larger listed hospital chains and a leading private hospital group in Telangana and Andhra Pradesh.
parts.RIVALS: Apollo Hospitals, Yashoda Hospitals, Care Hospitals, Aster DM Healthcare and Manipal Hospitals.
parts.WATCH: Watch new hospitals it is opening in Bengaluru, Maharashtra and other cities, its 2026 entry into Kerala through a hospital management deal in Palakkad, and how quickly new beds fill.

quiz.prompt: Where does KIMS earn most of its revenue?
Which hospital chain is a rival to KIMS?

companies.note_30w: KIMS runs multi-specialty hospitals across Telangana, Andhra Pradesh, Maharashtra and Karnataka. Its home states earn most; watch new hospitals filling beds.
